newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays tightly mixed by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays tightly mixed by close.

text.p: White sugar futures stayed tightly mixed by the close on Friday with prominent interest centred on spot August, traders said.
But much of the volume came from crosses and against actuals trades and the range on the spot position was a tight 90 cents, they said.
August closed 30 cents up at $318.30, October was unchanged at $307.70 while December fell 10 cents at $305.70.
Overall volume was 1,213 lots, the vast majority of which was in August.
Activity is expected to be subdued into next week as players gather in New York for Wednesday's Sugar Dinner.
August is said to be deriving support from Russian purchases of European white sugar, in addition to the expected hefty arrivals of Brazilian and Cuban raws.
"The August is still going on the back of supposed Russian interest...but there's starting to be some support even further down the board," said one trader.
He noted increased interest at lower levels from end-users who had previously been deterred by high prices.
